summary: The ascending and descending sorts are fixed and tested. Tasks without a due date sort first when descending, and nothing tests that case.

findings.title: AC-3 fails when descending: undated tasks sort first
findings.detail: Undated tasks are given the largest timestamp and the descending order is produced by reversing the ascending result, which moves them to the front. No test builds a task with a null due date.
findings.evidence: sort.ts line 32: 'return direction === "asc" ? sorted : sorted.reverse();'. A scratch test with one undated task returned it first for direction desc.
findings.requiredChange: Keep tasks with no due date last in both directions, and add a test named for AC-3 that asserts both orders.

findings.title: AC-2 has no test
findings.detail: The test file adds a test for the ascending order only, so the descending order required by AC-2 is unasserted.
findings.evidence: sort.test.ts line 23 is the only new test found.
findings.requiredChange: Add a test for AC-2 that asserts the descending order.
